title: 20 Chest Catches
description: Use a soft ball or rolled-up socks and practise bringing each catch safely into your chest.

title: Hook Footwork Practice
description: Practise approaching from a safe angle and placing your hurley into the hook position without making contact.
target: Complete 10 controlled approaches from each side

title: Solo End-Line Challenge
description: Solo through a safe lane and keep the sliotar balanced until you cross the finish line.

title: Dribble Through Gates
description: Use short touches to dribble the sliotar through a set of small gates.

title: Four Corner Strikes
description: Set four safe targets and practise striking the sliotar along the ground toward each one.

title: Block Position Reps
description: Practise stepping into a balanced frontal block position with your hurley safely placed.
target: Complete 10 controlled block positions from each side

title: Strike for Points
description: Strike from the hand toward a safe target and count your accurate attempts.
target: Complete 20 strikes and hit the target at least 10 times

title: High Catch Challenge
description: Ask a partner to throw a soft ball above head height and practise moving underneath it before catching.
